settings.phase_flip: sign(-sin(chi+asin(0.1))), own astigmatic CTF; output protein-positive
settings.threshold: median + k*1.4826*MAD of LoG response over valid area
settings.contamination_mask: bin-4 local (68 A Gaussian) mean |robust z|>5 or RMS robust z>5, dilated 57 A
settings.ridge: max(0,-l1-|l2|) Hessian, sigma 7 A, in units of the robust SD of d2/dx2

arm_rules.method: DP ridge path from r=25 A, <=1 theta bin per 2.5 A ring, lateral penalty
